_source: Five Parsecs: Planetfall p.59, Scout Discovery table (D100). Text verbatim from docs/rules/planetfall_source.txt === PAGE 61 ===.
_notes: Replaces the inline table PlanetfallScoutReportsPanel carried until 2026-10-28. 'effect' is the machine-readable id PlanetfallMap.apply_discovery() acts on; 'scout_xp' is the +2 XP the page grants an assigned scout.

entries.name: Routine trip
entries.description: The scouts find nothing at all.

entries.name: Good practice
entries.description: The scouts find nothing, but it is a good opportunity to rehearse the basics. If a scout was assigned, they receive +2 XP.

entries.name: SOS signal
entries.description: The scouts report a distress signal. This campaign turn you have the choice of playing a Rescue Mission. If you do not, Colony Morale drops by -3. Note: You do NOT suffer Morale loss from casualties sustained in this mission.

entries.name: Scout Down!
entries.description: The scout vehicle crashes. If you assigned a scout, they need rescue. You can opt to have them escape on foot. If so, they must roll on the post-battle injury table but earn +2 XP if they survive, or you can play the Scout Down! mission this turn to rescue them. If you did not assign a scout, the crash left no survivors. (If you would really like to play the mission, go ahead and do so this turn. You get +1 Colony Morale for your dedication).

entries.name: Exploration report
entries.description: Select any sector that has not yet been Explored and generate Resource and Hazard levels.

entries.name: Recon patrol
entries.description: If there are Tactical Enemies on the map, select one and add an Enemy Information for them. If there are currently no Tactical Enemies present, treat this as no event.

entries.name: Ancient Sign
entries.description: Randomly select a map sector, then mark that it has an Ancient Sign within it. Completing any mission in the sector awards the Ancient Sign.

entries.name: Revised survey
entries.description: Randomly pick a map sector. If it is not yet Explored, generate Resource and Hazard levels normally. If it is Explored but not yet Exploited, increase the Resource level by +1. If it has already been Exploited, generate new Resource and Hazard levels. You can Exploit it again.
